# Cloudflare security-audit-skill attribution

Agent Control's governed security-audit workflow adapts methodology from:

- Project: `cloudflare/security-audit-skill`
- Repository: https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill
- Inspected revision: `c1c8a8c1471069fb0e188eeaff69b8e8db6564a8`
- Licence: MIT
- Copyright: Copyright (c) 2025-2026 Cloudflare, Inc.

The six-phase lifecycle, coverage-led hunting, adversarial independent verification, three-verdict finding model, additive audits, and reporting discipline informed the Agent Control-native design. Production schemas, validators, orchestration, evidence binding, policy enforcement, CLI/API/dashboard integration, and tests are implemented against Agent Control abstractions; the upstream skill is not a runtime dependency.
